ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 60% high-intensity pixels (white) on lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity pixels (black) centered on the peduncle and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large bilateral contiguous white fields covering the majority of the lobes. A central black triangular region extends from the peduncle to the median notch, with dendritic black mottling and fine speckling encroaching into the white fields along the inner trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations increases significantly toward the distal tips, showing a jagged, irregular profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed sweep with initial concave curvature at the median notch transitioning to a broad convex curve reaching the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, irregular dark pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating significant surface texture variation. Isolated dark circular spots visible on the medial-ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the medial-distal white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular erosion and high-contrast textural 'bumping' at the distal tips, consistent with chronic scarring or parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical pixel-streaking from falling water droplets occurs along the trailing edge, intermittently occluding the sharp boundary of the contour.
